turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I really want to like black coffee, but right now I need two sugars and loads of milk.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can definitely train your taste. Would you rather cut the sugar and milk down bit by bit, or try a lighter roast that's naturally less bitter?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pause for a bit, my kid needs me. I'll come back to you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you already eat the last yoghurt?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, is it still raining out there?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just drizzling now. The sky looks lighter over the hills.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you think it'll clear up in time for the market?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Maybe. If not, we can just take umbrellas. It's only a ten minute walk.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: True. I really want those peaches before they sell out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then let's not wait too long. Grab your jacket.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Your black coffee mission. Cut down step by step, or switch roasts?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Bit by bit. One sugar starting tomorrow.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good start. After a couple of weeks your taste adjusts more than you'd think.
